Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$170,000 Annually
Experience Required: 8+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a VMware Engineer to design, deploy, and operate VMware-based virtualization, software-defined networking, and software-defined storage platforms across on-premises and hybrid cloud environments. The role covers vSphere, vSAN, NSX, Aria, and Tanzu, with a focus on automation, capacity management, and the practical realities of operating a large VMware estate alongside modern cloud-native workloads. The ideal candidate has operated VMware platforms at enterprise scale, navigates the evolving VMware product landscape pragmatically, and brings strong automation and operations discipline.
Key Responsibilities

• Design and operate VMware vSphere, vSAN, and NSX environments across data centers and hybrid cloud deployments.

• Build and maintain Tanzu Kubernetes Grid environments for containerized workloads.

• Implement vRealize / Aria Automation for self-service VM provisioning, lifecycle management, and policy enforcement.

• Operate NSX-T for software-defined networking, including micro-segmentation and load balancing.

• Manage vSAN clusters, storage policies, and storage performance for diverse workload classes.

• Implement disaster recovery and business continuity using Site Recovery Manager and replication.

• Build automation for VMware infrastructure using PowerCLI, Terraform, Ansible, and vRO.

• Design capacity management strategies including right-sizing, reservation, and workload placement.

• Operate VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) deployments where applicable, applying lifecycle management, workload domain design, and integration patterns appropriate to the broader hybrid cloud strategy.

• Implement and operate VMware integrations with cloud providers (VMware Cloud on AWS, AVS, GCVE).

• Build observability for VMware infrastructure including performance, capacity, and compliance.

• Lead VMware upgrades, lifecycle management cycles, and security patching across the virtualization estate, planning carefully sequenced rollouts that minimize disruption to dependent workloads.

• Troubleshoot complex VMware issues spanning compute, network, and storage layers.

• Stay current with VMware product evolution following the Broadcom transition.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

• Five or more years of hands-on VMware platform engineering experience.

• Deep expertise in vSphere, vCenter, and ESXi.

• Hands-on experience with vSAN and storage policy management.

• Experience with NSX-T or NSX-V networking.

• Strong PowerCLI scripting skills and experience with automation tooling.

• Familiarity with Tanzu Kubernetes Grid or VMware container platforms.

• Strong understanding of disaster recovery patterns and SRM.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across compute, network, and storage layers.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or VCAP credentials.

• Experience with VMware Cloud on AWS, AVS, or GCVE.

• Familiarity with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF).

• Experience with Aria Operations / vRealize Operations.

• Exposure to migration programs out of VMware to alternative virtualization platforms.

title: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) - Taunton, MA
description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

title: Territory Partner, Field Sales
description:
1099 Independent Contractor, Commission-Based

The Role
Every town has hundreds of small businesses run by people who are great at their trade and have no time for marketing. Omada AI gives them an AI marketing team for a fraction of what an agency costs. Territory Partners are the people who put it in their hands.

This is real field sales. You walk into local businesses, pitch the owner face to face, and get them live on Omada that same day. Your territory, your pipeline, your deals, your income.

It’s a 1099, commission-based role, built for closers who want to own what they earn. Every close raises your rate, grows a book that keeps paying you, and moves you toward running a city. We’re launching new cities every month, and the people who join now are the ones who will lead them.

If you know what it feels like to turn an empty morning into three signed customers by dinner, keep reading.

How You Get Paid

Six figures in year one is a real target here. Territory Partners who close 3 to 4 customers a week are on pace for $100K+ in their first year. What you earn comes down to what you close.

Our comp plan is called the Builder Plan. It pays you for every customer you close, and your rate only moves in one direction.

- A first-close bonus. Cash when your first customer pays.

- Commission on every close. Your per-close rate steps up at 10 and 25 career closes, then stays at the top rate for good. Your count never resets and you never get moved back down.

- Milestone cash bonuses. Paid at 10, 25, 50, and 100 career closes.

- Residuals on your book. Consistent producers earn a quarterly residual on customers who stay with Omada. The book you build keeps paying you.

- A production guarantee in your first four weeks. While you’re getting started, weeks where you hit the close target come with a guaranteed minimum.

- Leadership overrides. City Captains earn a share of everything their city collects.

Commissions pay once the customer’s payment clears, and there are no clawbacks on validated closes.

The Straight Deal
We want people who choose this with their eyes open, so here it is plainly.

- You’re an independent contractor (1099), not a W2 employee. There is no salary, hourly wage, or employee benefits. You handle your own taxes and expenses.

- You’re paid on results. Closed, paying customers. Not hours.

- You own your schedule and your pipeline. Nobody books your meetings, and nobody caps what you earn.

The reps who do well here wouldn’t want it any other way.

What You’ll Do

- Prospect your territory. Walk-ins, door pulls, referrals, networking groups, local events. Whatever works. The pipeline is yours.

- Sell face to face. Pitch owners in person and start them on a live free trial on the spot. We don’t do demos or demo accounts. You build their system on their real business, with their real content, in front of them.

- Own the full cycle. From first conversation to trial to paying customer, the deal is yours.

- Learn the product fast. Most reps are pitching confidently within a day or two. The product isn’t the hard part. The hustle is.

- Know your numbers. Track your activity and your accounts so you can see what’s working and close more each week.

How We Set You Up to Win

- You start in the field with a veteran. Your first weeks are next to an experienced Territory Partner. Watch their pitches, prospect together, then close your own deals with their backup. Commission is shared on the deals you close together.

- A product that sells. Owners need marketing help and most can’t afford an agency. Omada does the work of one for a fraction of the price. In front of the right owner, it sells.

- Support behind your accounts. Ongoing product training and a customer success team that helps your trials turn into paying customers.

- A real path up. TP → Vanguard → City Captain → State Director → Regional Director. We launch new cities every month, and we fill those leadership seats from the field.
